description: Trade desk: every agent trade idea is a case file the agents sign in turn; any veto stops it. The agents may hold at most max_agent_positions coins at a time, $25 each. Your own trades from the Trade tab skip the desk (you are the decision-maker) but never the $80 shutdown. Simulated money only. Set auto_practice_trades to false to have the agents review ideas without placing practice trades. Safety (step 1): the agents stop buying for the rest of the UTC day once their closed trades lose max_daily_loss_dollars. There is NO fixed take-profit: monitor.profit_trail lets winners run and sells when the profit falls tiers' giveback_points (percentage POINTS of return, after estimated selling costs) below the best profit reached; e.g. best +20% with 6 points -> sell at +14%; the lock rises as the best profit rises, and once active it never locks below min_lock_profit_pct. The trail starts once the best profit reaches the first tier's from_profit_pct; before that the stop-loss, max hold and trend exits apply. The Emergency Stop switch (phone app or `python -m vicekrack desk-emergency engage`) halts the agents and sells what they hold.
